## Source hierarchy

Tier A:
primary documents, official datasets, peer-reviewed/authoritative technical sources.

Tier B:
high-quality secondary reporting, academic explainers, institutional summaries.

Tier C:
community discussion or social signal; never sole support for material factual claims.
